hints.title: Simulation with State
hints.text: Track accumulated points and remaining health and shield at each room.

hints.title: Potion Boosts
hints.text: Use dynamic programming over (room_index, remaining_potions) to choose optimal room entries.

hints.title: State Transition
hints.text: At each room, either enter directly or consume a potion to boost health by hp_boost before absorbing damage.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Memoized states over room index, health, shield, and remaining potions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all 2^n potion decisions without memoization causes exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization cache trades O(states) memory for polynomial search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clear recursive state transitions with memoization.
